news_summary: Delhi Capitals signed Karnataka all-rounder Uma Kashvi for Rs 10 lakh at the WPL 2027 mini-auction in Kochi, at 15 years and 202 days, making her the youngest player ever to secure a Women's Premier League contract.
payoff: Delhi called it a long-term investment.
